name: cofiex-scorer
description: Simulates COFIEX technical evaluation of a carta-consulta under Res. Normativa 1/2024 (amended by Res. 32/2025, 142/2026, 150/2026, 151/2026). Outputs score range (Annex II rubric), eliminatory check (Art. 28), sublimit viability gate, senior MDB review, GTEC questions, iteration/persistence analysis, and correction plan.
